author: GamingBolt
description:
GTA 6 is steamrolling its way toward the long-awaited global release it has been building up to, and Rockstar has been more than happy to make up for its long silence about the game since it lifted the curtain. That means a lot of new information is cropping up regularly, which is significant considering the sheer scale of Leonidas and the story it aims to tell.

Thankfully, we’re on top of it all and have a new set of details you might want to know if you’re thinking about diving in next month. Sit back and enjoy this one, as it brings interesting content to the table.
